title: AI can act exactly like a human, but we still don't think it's conscious
hook_text: AI can act exactly like humans.
script:
AI can act exactly like a human, but we still do not think it is conscious.
Researchers at Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich investigated why people deny consciousness to machines.
Modern language models process language and exhibit behavior indistinguishable from people in conversation.
Despite this advanced mimicry, psychological studies show humans consistently refuse to attribute actual sentience to them.
Would you ever grant moral rights to an artificial system?
